Method.name: GetTransactionTypes
Method.Description: This request returns TransactionTypes in response
Method.Implementation:
set ^webService("GetTransactionTypes Start") = $ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3, 1) Set tArr = [] #dim rs As %SQL.StatementResult
Set rs = ##class(%SQL.Statement).%ExecDirect(,"SELECT * FROM IHC_TPManage.TransactionType") While rs.%Next() { set ^webService("GetTransactionTypes TransactionType:") = (rs.%Get("Name")) Do tArr.%Push({ "Operation":"GetTransactionTypes", "TransactionType": (rs.%Get("Name")), "Version": (rs.%Get("Version")), "Type": (rs.%Get("Type")) })
} set ^webService("GetTransactionTypes") = "End: " _ $ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3, 1) Do ..%SetStatusCode(200)
return tArr
